data.name: Gopu
data.gender_notes: Gopu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Gopu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gopa’, meaning ‘cowherd’. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with the cowherd deity, Krishna, who is revered as a divine figure and the embodiment of love and devotion. The name Gopu symbolizes dedication, selflessness, and service to God. The name Gopu carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gopu usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
